paper_title: Plasma proteomic profiles predict individual future health risk
prediction_task: Future health risk prediction for 14 disease categories from plasma proteomics (52K UK Biobank)

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Unclear how the feature (ProRS?) is calculated from model output. Cross-validation procedure needs more detail — is the full NN + survival pipeline done leave-one-region-out or has some steps been carried for all data?
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Clarified ProRS calculation and full CV pipeline details.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: GitHub link does not work. Why is network called a 'residual network' when no residual connections are used? Several sentences are unclear.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Fixed GitHub link, corrected terminology, improved clarity.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: What does 'before and after baseline' mean? Does each patient appear with different covariates for different outcomes? The comorbid network claim of 'overwhelmingly estimating health conditions' is unclear.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Clarified temporal modeling and toned down claims.

reviewer_strengths.text: Important contribution due to the scope (52K+ samples, Olink proteomics, 14 disease categories). Manuscript is well-written with vigorous methodology.
Paper is easy to follow and analysis appears thorough and convincing.
